name: Spec Kit
summary: Toolkit that gives AI coding agents structured processes for spec-driven development, bug fixing and idea assessment.
description: Open source toolkit that gives AI coding agents structured processes, reusable templates and documented outcomes. It ships three independent workflows: spec-driven development (constitution, specify, plan, tasks, implement, converge), bug fixing (assess, fix, test, ending in a verified/partial/failed verdict) and idea assessment (intake, research, define, shape, decide). Setup runs through a Python CLI; each step is then invoked as a /speckit-* agent skill inside a supported coding agent and reviewed before continuing.
contains: three processes: spec-driven development, bug fixing, idea assessment
agent skills invoked in chat: /speckit-specify, plan, tasks, implement, converge
bug fixing path: assess, fix, test with verified/partial/failed verdict
idea assessment path: intake, research, define, shape, decide
customizable via extensions, presets, workflows and bundles
requires Python 3.11+ and uv for the CLI
